arguments.sql:
SELECT p.id, p.publisher_name, COUNT(s.id) AS tall_heroes
FROM main.publisher AS p
LEFT JOIN main.superhero AS s
    ON s.publisher_id = p.id AND s.height_cm > 200
GROUP BY p.id, p.publisher_name
ORDER BY p.id
